fields.description:

Thrustmaster T 80 is a steering wheel and pedals used by gamers for racing games. This model is the most popular. It features a convenient design, feels comfortable in your hands thanks to its textured rubber coating, and has a sleek, modern design. fields.description: The ONYX Plus wireless controller is the next step in PS4 gaming. For years, PlayStation 4 gamers have been limited to one type of controller. The wide body fits comfortably in your hands, and the offset analog button layout is reminiscent of more modern console controllers. A 3.5 mm audio jack for full immersion in audio and strategic conversations between players. New PC compatibility for all types of games. For gamers who haven't yet purchased a PlayStation 4, despite the large collection of exclusive games for this platform, now is the time to invest. Enjoy exclusive PlayStation 4 games on a controller that suits your playing style тАФ it's all in your hands. Officially licensed by Sony.

fields.name: Monitor 23.8" ASUS VA249HG

The 4000:1 contrast ratio adds depth to colors, and the 300 cd/m┬▓ brightness ensures image brightness.

In addition, this monitor supports HDR technology and reproduces 95% of the DCI-P3 color space, which means excellent color quality and high contrast.
